    - heading "CONSTRUCT & VERIFY" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Build both triangles using the given data. Adjust the dials and side, then check if the triangles are congruent.
    - button "Reset":
      - img
      - text: Reset
    - article:
      - heading "Triangle 1" [level=2]
      - text: △ABC
      - complementary:
        - text: ∠A = ∠D
        - slider "Angle A": "50"
        - strong: 50°
        - text: 0° 180° ∠B = ∠E
        - slider "Angle B": "70"
        - strong: 70°
        - text: 0° 180° Included side AB
        - button "−"
        - status: "6"
        - button "+"
      - img "ASA triangle ABC": A B C 50° 70° 6
      - navigation:
        - button "Triangle 1 tool 1": ↖
        - button "Triangle 1 tool 2": •
        - button "Triangle 1 tool 3": ╱
        - button "Triangle 1 tool 4": △
        - button "Triangle 1 tool 5": ↶
        - button "−"
        - button "+"
    - article:
      - heading "Triangle 2" [level=2]
      - text: △DEF
      - complementary:
        - text: ∠D = ∠A
        - slider "Angle D": "50"
        - strong: 50°
        - text: 0° 180° ∠E = ∠B
        - slider "Angle E": "70"
        - strong: 70°
        - text: 0° 180° Included side DE
        - button "−"
        - status: "6"
        - button "+"
      - img "ASA triangle DEF": D E F 50° 70° 6
      - navigation:
        - button "Triangle 2 tool 1": ↖
        - button "Triangle 2 tool 2": •
        - button "Triangle 2 tool 3": ╱
        - button "Triangle 2 tool 4": △
        - button "Triangle 2 tool 5": ↶
        - button "−"
        - button "+"
    - heading "VERIFY CONGRUENCE" [level=2]
    - article:
      - heading "• Third angle (calculated)" [level=3]
      - paragraph: ∠C = 180° − (50° + 70°) = 60°
      - paragraph: ∠F = 180° − (50° + 70°) = 60°
    - article:
      - heading "Overlay check" [level=3]
      - img "ASA overlay check": A,D B,E C,F
      - strong:
        - img
        - text: All parts match perfectly. △ABC ≅ △DEF (ASA)
    - article:
      - heading "• Corresponding parts" [level=3]
      - paragraph:
        - text: ∠A = ∠D 50 = 50
        - img
      - paragraph:
        - text: ∠B = ∠E 70 = 70
        - img
      - paragraph:
        - text: AB = DE 6 = 6
        - img
      - paragraph:
        - text: ∠C = ∠F 60 = 60
        - img
      - text: "Result: Triangles are congruent by ASA."
    - article:
      - heading "WHY IT WORKS" [level=2]
      - paragraph: In ASA, two corresponding angles fix the directions of two rays from one vertex. The included side fixes the distance between those rays.
      - img: "6"
      - text: ↔
      - img: "6"
    - article:
      - heading "WORKED EXAMPLE" [level=2]
      - paragraph: "Given: ∠A = ∠D = 50°, AB = DE = 6, ∠B = ∠E = 70°"
      - paragraph: "Then: ∠C = ∠F = 60°"
      - strong:
        - text: Therefore, △ABC ≅ △DEF (ASA)
        - img
      - paragraph: "Correspondence: A ↔ D, B ↔ E, C ↔ F"
    - article:
      - heading "COMMON MISCONCEPTION" [level=2]:
        - img
        - text: COMMON MISCONCEPTION
      - paragraph: The known side must be between the two known angles. If the side is not included between the two angles, ASA does not apply.
      - img: "6"
      - img: 6 ×

      - heading "CHALLENGE YOURSELF" [level=2]:
